title: switcher blades
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that automatically swaps the player’s dominant hand when attacking.
body:
This is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.x that automatically switches the player’s dominant (main) hand whenever they successfully hit an entity.

The purpose of this mod is to introduce a small but noticeable combat variation. Each time the player lands a hit, the main hand swaps, creating a dynamic and slightly unpredictable fighting rhythm. The mod does not add new items, blocks, entities, or gameplay systems - it only modifies the player’s active hand behavior during combat.

Features

Automatically swaps main hand on every successful hit

Client-side only

No new content added

Lightweight and minimal performance impact

Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.x

Fabric Loader

Java 21

This mod is intended for players who want a small experimental combat twist without altering core game mechanics.
